question: Could a withdrawal from my RDSP make me repay more in government grants or bonds than I actually withdraw?
generated_answer: Yes. You may have to repay more in government grants or bonds than you actually withdraw from your RDSP. This is because the amount of government grants and bonds you may have to repay is based on the amount you withdraw, not the amount of your actual withdrawal. For example, if you withdraw $10,000 from your RDSP, you may have to repay $12,000 in government grants and bonds, even if you only actually withdrew $10,000. This is because the government grants and bonds are based on the amount you withdrew, not the amount of your actual withdrawal.
